Six orbits support 32 labeled edge configurations, each with <=4 open edges hence disconnected. Independently checked all 36 vertex-disjoint nonempty edge-family moment factorization identities in Q[t]/(F(t)), giving full 1-independence by inclusion-exclusion, not merely pairwise edge independence. All marginals equal p*. Independent thinning extends zero connectivity to 0<=p<=p*. No upper-bound optimality asserted.
